fullDesc: Suleiman became Ottoman sultan in 1520 and ruled for 46 years. Under him the empire reached its height, with conquests in Europe, a strong navy and a golden age of law and architecture.
realFacts: He took Belgrade in 1521 and besieged Vienna in 1529
He was called the Lawgiver in Turkey
The architect Sinan built great mosques
His wife Hürrem was powerful at court
